kind: owner-attended DV playback observation and source diagnosis

software.source_candidate_after_fix: mpv-fel-system-dv with patch 0010 (candidate tree c135087e9906135315268eda50b49ffc2f562f1b); compiled, not packaged or installed

owner_report: Watched for a few minutes and it was fine, with all enhancements (FEL, RPU, DYN pills). Then seeked forward 30 seconds; FEL no longer shows as active, only RPU and DYN.

observation.method: Read-only mpv IPC get_property recorder at a requested 4 Hz (853 samples over 212.9 s) alongside the owner's session; player journal lines read afterwards. No property was set and no command was sent.
player_journal_order: first successful private map reported enhancement-layer composition
seek outside the live session; the player re-created the session
provider reset diagnostic 2.85 s after the re-creation log
no further mapped-frame diagnostic to the end of the window
observation.native_dovi_target_state: active, generation 1 on every sample with video, before and after the re-creation's start-file
observation.decoded_colour: colormatrix dolbyvision, transfer PQ on every sample with video
observation.drop_counters: renderer, decoder and VO-delayed counters 0 throughout

diagnosis.pill: The provider's first-map diagnostic reported EL composed=1, so a dual-layer stream reached the device: the server's native Dolby Vision route, on which the server's route code never marks FEL active. On that route the overlay can draw only its local EL pill (cinema.lua enhancement_state), which needs the player's renderer facts; RPU and DYN do not. The owner's 'FEL' is therefore most likely that EL pill. The recorder did not capture the overlay input, so FEL versus EL is inferred from the code path, not observed.
diagnosis.player_contract: The player clears its renderer facts at start-file and restores them only from the VO's physical-target success record whose generation matches native-dovi-target-state, as the property's documentation requires for a source change.
diagnosis.renderer_cause: Patch 0002 logged the success record once per render generation. A seek or new file resets the frame queue and the provider without changing that generation, so after the re-creation no fresh record could be logged.
diagnosis.mapping_continuity: Not measured in this window: no mapper probe ran. In the separately measured November 17 replacement on the same route (evidence/dv-live-session-replacement-20261117.json), 187 positive-RPU, enhancement-layer-composed entries had mapped returns after replacement.
diagnosis.fix: Patch 0010 clears the logged flag where the VO resets its frame queue and provider. The record still prints only from a successful private map on the physical path.
diagnosis.reset_line: native-dovi-target-state stayed active generation 1 on every sample, which is consistent with the provider's 'raw RPU absent or stream reset' line coming from the reset branch at the stream change rather than a sustained absence of RPU.

limits: The recorder did not capture the overlay's input property, the selected video track's Dolby Vision profile or the mpv log stream; the pill identity follows from the code path and the provider's enhancement-layer composition diagnostic.
No mapper-return probe ran during this window; mapping continuity after this re-creation is inferred from the November 17 measurement on the same route, not measured here.
The host had heavy concurrent build load during the window; no drops were reported.
The owner's report covers the on-screen pills, not a measured picture difference. No optical measurement was made.
Patch 0010 is compiled but not packaged. The rebuilt package, its installation and the attended re-check on the ROG remain owner-coordinated.

The success record attests a successful private map, not enhancement-layer composition, and it is edge-triggered; an enhancement-layer-only loss with mapping still succeeding would not clear the EL pill. A level-triggered composition field on native-dovi-target-state would be sturdier (follow-up).
